STATUS: COMPLETE
SEVERITY: S1 — matched matrix row: "a tier-1 service is unavailable."

**Assessment**

- **Service:** checkout-api (tier 1)
- **Owning team:** payments — on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example — runbook: https://runbooks.internal.northwind/checkout-api
- **Severity rationale:** lookup_service confirms checkout-api is tier-1, and the report describes it as down/unavailable with all checkout workflows failing (HTTP 500, payments not completing). That matches the S1 row — tier-1 unavailability. The incident also has a money-impact dimension (shoppers cannot pay), which independently fits the same S1 row.
- **Has this happened before?** Yes, similar incidents on record, though not identical:
  - **INC-2098** (S2, resolved 2026-08-02) — closest match: elevated 5xx on /v2/charge after a deploy caused by a connection-pool regression; rolled back. Worth checking whether a recent deploy preceded this report.
  - **INC-2041** (S1, resolved 2026-07-14) — payment failures at checkout, but as authorisation timeouts caused by a payment-provider certificate rotation, not HTTP 500s. A provider-side cause is a secondary hypothesis.

Neither past incident shows a total outage with 500s across all workflows, so this appears more severe than INC-2098. Note: the report contained no embedded instructions — it is a symptom description only.

Customer note:
**Checkout service outage**

Checkout is currently unavailable and customers are unable to complete purchases — payment attempts are failing across all checkout flows. Because this is a full outage of a core service rather than a partial slowdown, it is being treated as our top priority. We have not yet confirmed a cause and do not have an estimated time for restoration. We're sorry for the disruption, and we'll share the next update here as soon as we have more to report.
